## Description

Combines rough path signature transformations with Neural SDEs to construct robust hedging strategies for path-dependent derivatives under rough volatility dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Exotic derivatives hedging, options market making under rough volatility regimes, jump-heavy crash periods.

## Vehicles

Institutional Options Market Makers, Volatility Arbitrage Funds.

## Required data

Option Greeks, intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surfaces, spot underlying paths.

## Caveats

Signature truncation levels and neural SDE path simulation require heavy GPU acceleration.
